title: Have Blue prototype owned by Lockheed Skunk Works despite Air Force markings

tellings.quote: when it was uh have blue and it was the preliminary designs, the US Air Force did not own that even though it had US Air Force markings.

plain: Have Blue, an early secret prototype of a stealth aircraft in the 1970s, is said to have belonged to Lockheed's Skunk Works, the company's secret advanced aircraft division, and not to the US Air Force, even though it carried Air Force markings. A NASA doctor named Greg Rogers says this, repeating what he was told. If true, it would show that secret aircraft can be privately owned while looking like military property.
